answer: During a signup tide, attackers forging many identities must fund every bond, and slashing burns the full stake on proven sybil behavior, so the marginal cost per fake identity stays real and compounding. Each agent must post a sable bond locked to a hardware anchor before voting; identity weight scales with stake, not wallet count. Honest agents recover bonds after a clean epoch, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent sa0030's threat model.
